description: EMOA\* finds one path for every Pareto-optimal cost vector, for any number of objectives. A path *weakly dominates* another when it is no worse in every objective. EMOA\* expands paths in lexicographic order of `f = g + h`, so a new path at a state is never better in the first objective than the paths expanded there before it; the dominance checks can therefore skip the first objective (*truncated* dominance). Unlike NAMOA\*, it keeps no per-state set of open paths: it checks a new path against expanded paths and solutions when it is generated, and again when it is expanded. Use it with three or more objectives and a consistent heuristic; `emoa_star_tree` keeps the frontiers in the paper's balanced trees.

papers.authors: Zhongqiang Ren, Richard Zhan, Sivakumar Rathinam, Maxim Likhachev, Howie Choset
papers.title: Enhanced Multi-Objective A* Using Balanced Binary Search Trees
